title: Backend API SDK sends its configured secret key as a bearer token
intent: Distilled from backend SDKs such as Clerk and Paystack: the client stores options.secretKey on this.secretKey and sends it in an Authorization header on every request, which is the API's intended authentication, not wallet key material. code.key-material-exfiltration only treats secretKey as key material on a keypair-shaped holder (keypair, wallet, signer, …), so this must stay quiet. The module is unchanged in this patch, so the release rolls up low.
